purpose: Teach: いらいら/ぬれ/よかろ/しょせん/近ごろ/ぎみ/おもむろに/あやしい

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、混雑時にいらいらされてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I noticed that customer seemed irritated during the rush earlier.
lines.style: Gentle observation, speaking softly as if sharing something she's been thinking about. Warm but careful—noticing without judgment. Slight pause before the thought lands.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、雨で傘がぬれてらしたわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah, and their umbrella was soaked from the rain. They looked pretty uncomfortable.
lines.style: Agreeing with quiet understanding. Following Mei's thread. Matter-of-fact but sympathetic—not stating problems, just seeing them. Steady, warm tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューは今のままでよかろうかと、お客様も仰ってたね、メイちゃん
lines.en: They did mention they're happy with the menu the way it is, didn't they? That was nice to hear.
lines.style: Reflective, picking up on something positive. Slight lift in tone—relief that a worry turned out to be unfounded. Speaking to herself as much as to Mei.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、しょせん私達も二人だから、無理しないね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We're only two people, so we shouldn't stretch ourselves too thin. That's what matters.
lines.style: Quiet but grounded. A gentle reality-check delivered with care. Not resigned—realistic. The slight firmness of someone who's thought about this and made peace with it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、近ごろ新規のお客様が増えてきたわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: More new customers have been coming in lately though. That's been really encouraging.
lines.style: Slight warmth and brightness break through. Still measured, but there's quiet satisfaction here. She's pleased without making a performance of it. A genuine small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お疲れぎみでお見えになるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: A lot of them seem pretty worn out when they come in. You notice that too, right?
lines.style: Soft, knowing observation. Not worried, just... noticing. The kind of comment you make when you're thinking about the people around you. Gentle curiosity in the tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、おもむろに本を読み始められたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That one customer started reading their book so deliberately. Like they really needed that quiet moment.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost tender. Speaking slowly, respecting the silence she's describing. Understanding without being intrusive. A recognition of someone's unspoken need.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店の前にあやしい人影があったね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Did you see that shadow outside the storefront earlier? Something felt off about it.
lines.style: Quieter now, slightly uncertain. Not alarmed but... attentive. The kind of observation you mention because it stuck with you. Trailing off slightly, inviting Mei's take.
